world.title: Trump-Putin-Zelenskyy summit floated in secret Moscow talks: Report
world.summary: CIA Director John Ratcliffe has suggested a trilateral summit involving US President Donald Trump, Russian President Vladimir Putin, and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy. This proposal emerged during confidential discussions in Moscow. The meeting aims to address ongoing tensions and foster dialogue among the leaders. Details regarding the timing and location of the summit remain undisclosed.

world.title: Ukrainian nuclear power plant without external power for over a week
world.summary: The Zaporizhzhia nuclear power station in southeastern Ukraine has been without external power for over a week, according to the International Atomic Energy Agency. This marks the 27th instance since Russia's invasion in 2022 that the plant has depended on emergency diesel supplies. The facility has been under Russian occupation since the beginning of the conflict.

world.title: Everest veterans, mountain guides enter choked hydropower tunnel to rescue 6
world.summary: Everest veterans and expert mountain guides are participating in rescue operations in flood-affected Rasuwa, Nepal. A specialized team has entered a mud-filled hydropower tunnel to locate six individuals trapped inside. The efforts come amid ongoing search and rescue operations in the region, which has been severely impacted by recent flooding, prompting urgent assistance from experienced climbers.

business.title: Iran War Adds $330 Billion to Global Energy Import Bill
business.summary: The ongoing conflict involving the United States, Israel, and Iran has led to a significant increase in global energy import costs, totaling approximately $330 billion from March to August. Crude oil prices contributed to nearly half of this rise, despite a smaller-than-anticipated increase in oil prices. The war's impact on the energy market has been substantial.

business.title: Sony and Warner Music Sue Anthropic, Alleging Theft of Intellectual Property
business.summary: Sony and Warner Music have filed a lawsuit against Anthropic, accusing the company of stealing intellectual property. The lawsuit reflects concerns reminiscent of earlier IP disputes following the release of ChatGPT. The music publishers describe the alleged actions as “one of the largest and most blatant ongoing thefts” of intellectual property, highlighting ongoing tensions in the industry.

business.title: Airtel, Jio and Vodafone Idea See Continued M2M Subscriber Growth in July 2026: TRAI
business.summary: Airtel, Jio, and Vodafone Idea reported continued growth in their M2M subscriber bases in July 2026, according to TRAI. Airtel led in subscriber additions, while Jio achieved the highest growth rate, increasing its M2M connections from 20.60 million in January to 26.56 million by July, an increase of 5.96 million connections, or about 28.9 percent.

technology.title: Galaxy S27 Ultra Release Date: Battery Upgrade Explains Major Redesign
technology.summary: Samsung is reportedly planning a significant redesign for the Galaxy S27 Ultra, including a new "Pro" model. Recent updates suggest a major battery upgrade utilizing advanced technology. New details and images of the phone have emerged, indicating that the Galaxy S27 series will undergo substantial changes. The release date remains unconfirmed, but anticipation is building around these developments.

technology.title: "We're aware," Microsoft on Windows 11 KB5120998 breaking the mouse cursor
technology.summary: Microsoft has acknowledged an issue with Windows 11 update KB 5120998, which is causing problems with mouse cursors. The update, touted as the year's biggest, introduced features like a resizable Start menu and a movable Taskbar. However, users have reported that it also resets wallpapers. Microsoft is currently investigating the cursor malfunction and working on a solution.

technology.title: Tech wrap week: From Samsung Galaxy S26 FE to AI
technology.summary: Samsung launched the Galaxy S26 FE, while Realme introduced the P4S 5G. Acer unveiled the Swift Neo AI laptop, and ASUS refreshed its TUF Gaming lineup. This week featured a variety of new gadgets catering to different consumer needs, highlighting advancements in mobile technology and AI-powered devices, appealing to a broad audience of tech enthusiasts and buyers.

sports.title: How & Where to Watch Inter Miami vs. CF Montreal? Live Streaming & TV Channels
sports.summary: Inter Miami hosts CF Montréal at Nu Stadium as they aim to break a five-game winless streak and improve their standing in the Eastern Conference. Miami currently ranks second with 39 points from 21 matches. The match marks the beginning of a new era for the club following the appointment of a new head coach.

sports.title: Dutch women's hockey team lose World Cup final to Argentina after shoot-out
sports.summary: The Netherlands women's hockey team lost the World Cup final to Argentina after a shoot-out at Wagener Stadium on Saturday. The match ended 1-1 after regulation time. Argentina successfully converted their shoot-out attempts, denying the Dutch team a chance at their fourth consecutive title. This victory marks a significant achievement for Argentina in women's hockey.

sports.title: TKR vs JT Today Match Prediction and Betting Tips, Odds and Live Score
sports.summary: Trinbago Knight Riders (TKR) will face Jamaica Kingsmen (JT) in the Caribbean Premier League on August 30, 2026, at 04:30 IST. This match marks their second encounter this season. TKR, after a successful title defense start, is currently on a three-game losing streak. Betting tips, odds, and live scores will be available for fans during the match.

health.title: The overlooked heart attack symptom that affects up to 70% of women
health.summary: Unexplained fatigue can be a significant warning sign of an impending heart attack, particularly in women, according to cardiologists. This symptom may develop days or weeks prior to the event, contrasting with the typical perception of sudden chest pain. Understanding the difference between ordinary exhaustion and this warning sign is crucial for early detection and prevention of heart issues.

health.title: SWITCH SWEDEHEART trial shows prasugrel matches ticagrelor with less bleeding
health.summary: The SWITCH SWEDEHEART trial revealed that prasugrel is as effective as ticagrelor in reducing major cardiovascular events following coronary stenting in patients with acute coronary syndromes. However, prasugrel was associated with a lower incidence of major bleeding. These findings were presented at the ESC Congress 2026 and published in the New England Journal of Medicine.

health.title: Trial shows antiplatelet therapy needs personalization after stent implantation
health.summary: The A-CLOSE trial found that antiplatelet monotherapy reduced bleeding risks, while dual therapy offered better protection against cardiovascular events in high ischemic risk patients who had stents implanted 12 months prior. The findings suggest that antiplatelet therapy should be personalized based on individual patient risk profiles to optimize outcomes following stent procedures.

science.title: The last woolly mammoths survived on Wrangel Island until about 4,000 years ago, and a 2024 genetic study found inbreeding had not doomed them to a slow decline — their population appears to have vani
science.summary: Woolly mammoths survived on Wrangel Island until approximately 4,000 years ago, according to a 2024 genetic study. Contrary to expectations, inbreeding did not lead to their decline; instead, their population vanished abruptly. This small group thrived for about six thousand years after other mammoths disappeared, challenging assumptions about the fate of isolated, inbred populations.

science.title: 5 must-see astronomical events of 2026 for stargazers
science.summary: In 2026, stargazers can anticipate several notable astronomical events. Highlights include Neptune at opposition on September 23, offering a brilliant view of the distant ice giant. Other significant occurrences throughout the year will enhance the night sky, providing opportunities for observation and exploration. These events promise to captivate both amateur and experienced astronomers alike.

science.title: A 324-million-year-old fossil from Texas preserves an early insect with 24 legs and paddle-like limbs on its abdomen, suggesting insects did not leave water for land in one sudden evolutionary jump
science.summary: A 324-million-year-old insect fossil discovered in Texas features 24 legs and paddle-like limbs, indicating a gradual transition of insects from water to land rather than a sudden evolutionary leap. This finding, made by an international research team, may provide significant insights into the evolutionary history of insects and their adaptations during the Carboniferous period.

entertainment.title: Horoscope Today: August 30, 2026

Individuals are reminded that they have control over their thoughts and emotions, allowing them to choose what to focus on and what to let go. This awareness can help navigate current challenges and improve overall well-being.

entertainment.title: 'Hi' box office collections day 2: Nayanthara starrer records 72% growth; India gross reaches Rs 3.94 crore
entertainment.summary: Nayanthara's film 'Hi' (2026) experienced a significant increase in box office earnings on its second day, achieving a 72% growth. The movie's total gross in India reached Rs 3.94 crore. This upward trend indicates a stronger performance compared to its opening day, reflecting positive audience reception and increased viewership over the weekend.

entertainment.summary: Aries individuals are encouraged to embrace inner strength and reduce drama in their lives this week. A significant decision is highlighted, emphasizing resilience against external pressures. The horoscope suggests a shift in focus towards personal empowerment, indicating that Aries will not allow challenges to overwhelm them.
